deps-bot: Automated SCA alert: transitive dependency 'libwebp@1.3.0' pulled into `node:builder` image via image-minify@2.4. Severity: Medium. CVE-2025-4481 (out-of-bounds decode). Exploitability: low. Affected artifact: `redwood/ci-builder:2026-03-18`

alex: saw this in the weekly scan, flagged for the staging builder image. Do we need to block releases until it's upgraded?

doris: quick context: libwebp is used only in our image-minify step running in the builder (not in runtime images). No runtime customers should be affected. Proposal: temporary risk acceptance for the `release/*` branch CI builders for up to 30 days while infra lands an image rebuild with libwebp 1.4.0 and runs full regression. Compensating controls:
- restrict egress from builder runners to blocking list (`10.0.0.0/8` internal only)
- require image signing + pinned digest for any release artifact
- add an SBOM snapshot and full SCA scan on merge
- KMS audit log entry for the exception (audit key: sec:temp-exceptions)

sam: upgrading libwebp in the builder base is nontrivial — some of our node-gyp hooks break on the newer release. If we force it now some pipelines will fail and block customers. We can do a staged rebuild: 1) build a parallel `ci-builder-patched` image, 2) run canary pipelines for a day, 3) flip tags. ETA ~ 10 business days to fully validate.

marta: a few asks before I can OK the exception:
- list of repos/images impacted (just `redwood/ci-builder:2026-03-18`?)
- concrete rollback plan if the patched image causes failures (link to playbook)
- exact expiration timestamp for the exception (no open-ended approvals)
- evidence that none of the customer-facing runtime images include the vulnerable libwebp (SBOM diff)

doris: answers:
- impacted: `redwood/ci-builder:2026-03-18` and `redwood/minify-worker:staging` (both used only in CI and internal batch jobs)
- rollback: we will keep the old image under `ci-builder:v2026-03-18-frozen` and have the tag switch controlled by a PR with a gated deploy that can revert within 15 minutes (docs: https://go/internal/ci-deploys#rollback)
- expiration: request 30 days from now -> `2026-04-19T16:00:00Z` (will require re-review if not patched)
- SBOM: attaching short diff in thread (artifact: sbom/ci-builder-2026-03-18.diff)

jenny: bumped to me for approval. I support conditional temporary acceptance given the compensating controls and concrete plan. Requirements for approval:
- create a one-off Jira `SEC-EXC-216` with all details, CC security and infra
- add RBAC: only infra-eng and release-managers may approve the tag flip (no broad write access)
- require the KMS audit entry (doris can provide the audit log entry)
- notify customers via internal status page if anything changes during canary

marta: I'll sign off once SEC-EXC-216 exists and the RBAC change is in a PR. Also add a codeowner ping to `@eng-platform` for image changes. :eyes:

doris: will open SEC-EXC-216 now and add the SBOM + mitigation checklist. Will file RBAC PR (IAM change) and post the KMS audit entry here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — tagging the release team so they see the note: @release-team :shipit:

deps-bot: Note: this exception will be auto-revoked at expiration unless extended by a security reviewer. See policy: https://go/policies/temp-vuln-exceptions

jenny: approved (conditional). Marking last_action by 1769001820.
